name: Honeywell C7250A 20k NTC dry-bulb sensor (mixed air / outdoor air)
function: Wired 20k NTC thermistor into the JADE MAT (required) or OAT terminals (63-2700-11 p.2-3). Resistance falls as temperature rises. JADE uses MAT to modulate free cooling to MAT SET and for freeze protection (MA LO SET). C7250A spec data confirms a 20k NTC output, -40 to 150°F range, and OA C7250A + RA C7400S for differential dry bulb (63-1364EF-01 p.1).

availability.note: Ships with the Honeywell retrofit kit per project brief assumption.

location.note: The MA sensor is required for every JADE application (p.4); placement relative to the coil per Fig. 4 (p.5).

failureModes.name: Open
failureModes.goodVsBad: OL on the ohmmeter. JADE shows MA TEMP --.- and alarm MA T SENS ERR (63-2700-11 p.19, p.24).
failureModes.symptoms: Economizer won't free cool (or behaves per the JADE's fallback), compressors carry the load.

failureModes.name: Shorted
failureModes.goodVsBad: Near 0 Ω. JADE reads it as out of range: MA TEMP --.- and MA T SENS ERR.
failureModes.symptoms: Same as open: free cooling lost.

failureModes.name: Drifted out of calibration
failureModes.goodVsBad: Resistance doesn't match the chart at the reference temperature. No alarm; the reading is plausible but wrong.
failureModes.symptoms: Damper hunts, over-ventilates, or trips freeze protection early.

test.meter: Ω with sensor leads lifted from the JADE; reference thermometer at the sensor.
procedure: Read the MA TEMP on the JADE STATUS menu. Compare to your probe at the sensor.
Lift the sensor leads from the JADE (no line voltage involved, but don't short the terminals).
Ohm the sensor. Look up the expected resistance at your probe temperature on the C7250A chart.
Within ±2°F equivalent = good. Off more than that = drifted. OL/short = failed.
If it reads good on the bench but wrong in the unit: check mounting location and wiring.
safety: Low voltage, but the mixed air section has moving dampers. Keep fingers clear of blades and linkage when the actuator may stroke.

goodTolF.note: Honeywell lists C7250A accuracy as -0/+2°F (63-2700-11 p.2). The app uses ±2°F against your reference probe.

marginalTolF.note: 2-5°F off = marginal (recalibrate offset or replace), >5°F = bad.

symptoms.customer: "High electric bill in spring/fall," "unit runs all day when it's 60 out."
symptoms.tech: JADE alarm, ECONOMIZING never goes YES on a perfect free-cooling day, or damper hunting.

confusedWith: Sensor mounted in the wrong spot (reads RA or OA only, not mixed)
Wrong strategy/changeover setpoint locking out economizing

labCases.context: Verifying MAT during a JADE commissioning.

tests.label: Reference probe at sensor
tests.setup: Calibrated probe taped next to the sensor.

labCases.explanation: 35,100 Ω at 55°F is right on the chart (≈35,235 Ω). Good sensor.

labCases.context: JADE showing a MAT sensor error.
labCases.explanation: OL = open element or broken lead. Check the wire run before condemning the sensor.
22,950 Ω reads as ~71.5°F, so it's 3.5°F off your probe. Not dead, but enough to throw off MAT control. Use the JADE MAT T CAL offset or replace it.

labCases.context: JADE showing MA TEMP pegged high and a sensor error.
labCases.explanation: 12 Ω is a dead short, probably a pinched lead. Trace the wire before you replace the sensor.
